_note: What Kota says when the farmer talks to them (Talk, README.md, Villagers): the first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; the gift_ lines answer a gift by its reaction (gift_birthday on their birthday); gift_items names their own answer to a keepsake or a dish (Talk.gift_line), by item or by dish: / keepsake:<reaction> (gifts in data/villagers/kota.json). Our own lines.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Guess what! I'm a whole year older today. Mum made red rice and everything.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Wait, did you know already? Did Sayo tell you?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: A birthday present? For me?! I'm keeping this forever. Well, until I eat it.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: What? I'm busy! ...Okay, I'm not busy.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You keep coming back. Are you lonely up on that farm?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I saw the streamer from the pond path! It was flapping like it was swimming upstream.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Mum says I talk about your farm more than about school. That's because school is boring.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: When the wind drops, the carp streamer looks sleepy. Like the real one under the willow.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: When I grow up I'm gonna have a farm too. Bigger than yours!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: ...Can I help with the watering sometime?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I'll show you my secret fishing spot. Don't tell Hachiro.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Whoa, who are you? Oh, the new farm. I'm Kota!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Grandma Tome says I talk too much. I don't talk too much.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Shh! There's a big one under the lily pads. I saw it.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Nothing's biting. The fish are all asleep today.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Hachiro showed me how to read the current. The fish wait behind the rocks, where it's slow.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I'm gonna catch one bigger than Hachiro's. Then he has to carry my bucket home!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Don't tell Mum I waded out to the stepping rocks. I didn't. ...Not far.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I've got six cicadas! No, seven. One got out.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Did you hear that one? It's the loudest in the whole shrine!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: If it snows, I'm making a snowman as big as the torii.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I can run from my house to the shrine in forty steps. Wanna see?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Sayo gives me a dango if I help carry the rice. Best job ever.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Is it true you've got a pond on your farm? Any koi?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: No way! For me? For real?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You're the best! I'm showing everybody!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Ooh, thanks! That's pretty good.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Huh. Okay. Thanks, I guess.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Yuck... do I have to? ...Thanks.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Bleh! Mum makes me eat those. No way!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You already gave me stuff today. Grandma says don't be greedy.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: A clay rabbit! It's got little red eyes!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: It's going by the alcove at home. Nobody touches it but me.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: A daruma! I'll paint one eye in for my wish. Not telling you what it is.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Whoosh! Ha, this fan makes a real wind. Thanks!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: A charm? That's a grandma present... Okay. Thanks.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Huh, neat. I'll show it to Mum.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Pudding! It wobbles! You made this?!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I'm saving it for after dinner. Okay, maybe I'm eating it now.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Kinako mochi! I'm gonna get powder all over my face!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You cooked this for me? It's my favourite!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You cooked this? Smells really good. Thanks!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Food? Okay. I'll eat it if I get hungry.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Ugh, that's grown-up food... Do I have to eat all of it?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I'm entering my cucumber! It's crooked, but it's the biggest one I ever grew.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Did you see that firework? It went bang right in my chest!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Grandma says a rabbit lives on the moon making rice cakes. I'm looking for its ears.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I'm staying up till the year turns over. I'm not even a bit sleepy. Not even...
